title: Assert that a definitive checkpoint refusal falls back to exactly the turn's own observation
outcome: a_definitive_refusal_still_drops_the_report_to_its_fallback captures active_turn_report_fallback before the turn finishes, and asserts that the cached report after a definitive refusal equals it (non-empty, with the turn's own observations), so replacing it with an empty default would fail the test.
acceptance: Assert that a definitive checkpoint refusal falls back to exactly the turn's own observation is done
